Create product-spec.md, epic.md, and all 7 user stories (us-001 through us-007) for Space Invaders MVP.

**Product-Spec**: From issue #1035 game brief:
- **Product**: Space Invaders browser game (React + TypeScript + HTML5 Canvas)
- **Problem**: Recreate classic arcade with responsive controls (desktop + mobile)
- **Target Users**: Casual players, nostalgia seekers, arcade enthusiasts
- **Main V1 Capabilities**: Start screen, 11x5 enemy formation, player cannon with dual input (max 1 bullet), 4 destructible shields, enemy fire (max 3 bullets), mystery ship bonuses, AABB collision, wave progression
- **Key Business Rules**: Formation reaching player line = game over. All enemies destroyed = victory → new wave. Score persists; lives reset to 3.
- **Technical Stack**: React, TypeScript, HTML5 Canvas, requestAnimationFrame delta-time loop

**Epic 0 — MVP**: Complete, playable Space Invaders with all core mechanics.

**User Stories** (with Gherkin acceptance criteria):
- US-001: Setup (start button → game begins, HUD shows score=0, lives=3)
- US-002: Enemy Formation (11x5 grid, lateral movement, edge bounce + drop, speed scaling)
- US-003: Player Controls (arrow keys + spacebar desktop, swipe + touch button mobile, 1-bullet max)
- US-004: Shields (4 bunkers, segments degrade on bullet hit, formation contact)
- US-005: Enemy Fire (random intervals, max 3 bullets, hits player = -1 life + invincibility)
- US-006: Collisions & Scoring (AABB, player bullet + enemy = destroy + score, mystery ship bonus)
- US-007: Game States & Waves (victory → new wave with increased speed, lives reset, game over)

Place files in: apps/spaceinvaders/docs/what/ and apps/spaceinvaders/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/
Use templates: product-spec.md, epic.md, us.md

Create architecture.md. Read product-spec.md and all user stories from task A.

**Architecture Overview**:
- Stack: React + TypeScript + HTML5 Canvas + requestAnimationFrame
- Rendering: Canvas 2D for game, React DOM for HUD/UI
- Game Loop: delta-time via requestAnimationFrame
- State: React state for UI (score, lives, wave); refs for game loop state
- Entities: Formation, Player, Enemies, PlayerBullet, EnemyBullets (pooled), Shields, MysteryShip
- Collision: AABB for all pairs
- Object Pooling: Bullets reused
- Input: Desktop (keyboard) + Mobile (touch/swipe)

**Components**:
1. Game Loop Manager: requestAnimationFrame driver, delta-time
2. Rendering System: Canvas 2D rendering
3. Input System: Keyboard + Touch handlers
4. Physics/Collision: AABB detection + response
5. Entity Manager: Formation, enemies, bullets, shields, mystery ship lifecycle
6. State Machine: Game states (setup, playing, victory, gameOver)
7. UI Layer: React HUD (score, lives, wave), buttons

**Data Flow**: Input → State changes → Game Loop update → Collision checks → Score/state updates → UI rerender

**Non-Functional**: 60 FPS target, responsive desktop + mobile, visual feedback, difficulty scales with wave

Create Slice 1 — Foundation. Read epic and user stories from task A, architecture from task B.

**Slice Title**: Slice 1 — Foundation: Game Loop, Canvas Setup, UI Framework

**Description**: Foundational infrastructure: canvas initialization, React setup, game loop with delta-time, HUD component (score, lives, wave), state machine scaffolding.

**Deliverables**:
1. Canvas setup in React component
2. requestAnimationFrame game loop with delta-time calculation
3. React state for gameState, score, lives, wave
4. HUD component (score display, lives counter, wave indicator)
5. State machine transitions (setup → playing → gameOver/victory)
6. Input system scaffolding

**Related User Stories**: US-001 (setup), US-007 (game states)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: Canvas renders, loop runs at 60 FPS target, start button transitions to playing, HUD displays correctly, state transitions work

Create Slice 2 — Enemy Formation & Rendering. Read US-002, architecture.md, Slice 1.

**Slice Title**: Slice 2 — Enemy Formation & Rendering

**Description**: Enemy grid (11x5), sprites by type, lateral movement, edge bouncing, speed scaling, rendering.

**Deliverables**:
1. Enemy entity with position, type, points, alive flag
2. Formation manager: 11x5 grid initialization, lateral movement
3. Edge detection and direction reversal
4. Speed scaling based on enemy count
5. Sprite rendering for 3 enemy types (small/medium/large)
6. Formation.drop() for bouncing behavior
7. Game loop integration

**Related User Stories**: US-002 (formation), US-006 (destruction), US-007 (reset)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: 55 enemies in grid, smooth lateral movement, bounces at edges, speed increases as enemies die, 3 sprite types visible, reaching bottom = game over

Create Slice 3 — Player Control & Firing. Read US-003, architecture.md, Slice 1.

**Slice Title**: Slice 3 — Player Control & Firing

**Description**: Player cannon with dual input (keyboard + touch), movement bounds, bullet firing (1-max), invincibility frames.

**Deliverables**:
1. Player entity: position, bounds, sprite
2. Keyboard handler (left/right arrow, spacebar)
3. Touch handler (swipe detection, mobile fire button)
4. PlayerBullet entity: position, velocity, collision box
5. Bullet fire logic with 1-max constraint
6. Invincibility frame tracking
7. Player rendering with invincibility visual feedback

**Related User Stories**: US-003 (controls), US-005 (enemy bullets), US-006 (player bullets)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: Player at bottom center, arrow keys move with bounds, spacebar fires 1 bullet, mobile swipe/buttons work, invincibility frames + visual feedback, smooth rendering

Create Slice 4 — Destructible Shields. Read US-004, architecture.md, Slice 1.

**Slice Title**: Slice 4 — Destructible Shields

**Description**: 4 bunker shields as segment matrices, damage tracking per segment, visual degradation with opacity changes.

**Deliverables**:
1. Shield entity: 4x4 (or similar) segment matrix
2. Segment class: position, hit count, opacity, alive flag
3. Damage logic: hit increments counter, opacity decreases
4. Shield initialization: place 4 bunkers evenly between player and formation
5. Rendering: draw segments with opacity feedback
6. Segment removal: when degraded beyond threshold, segment disappears
7. Collision response: decrease segment health on any bullet hit

**Related User Stories**: US-004 (shields), US-005 (enemy fire), US-006 (collisions)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: 4 bunkers render between player and enemies, player bullets degrade segments, enemy bullets degrade, formation contact degrades, opacity changes visible, full degradation removes segment

Create Slice 5 — Collision Detection & Resolution. Read US-006, architecture.md, Slices 2-4.

**Slice Title**: Slice 5 — Collision Detection & Resolution

**Description**: AABB collision detection for all entity pairs (bullets, enemies, shields, player, formation) with proper collision response and scoring.

**Deliverables**:
1. AABB collision detection function (two rectangles overlap test)
2. Collision manager: iterate all entity pairs, detect overlaps
3. Collision response logic:
   - Player bullet + enemy → destroy enemy, add score (10/20/30 pts by type)
   - Player bullet + mystery ship → destroy ship, add bonus score (50/100/150/300 pts)
   - Enemy bullet + player → damage player, trigger invincibility
   - Any bullet + shield segment → degrade segment
   - Formation + shield → degrade segments
   - Formation + player line → trigger game over
4. Object pool management: bullets removed after collision or exit
5. Score update on enemy destruction

**Related User Stories**: US-006 (collisions/scoring), all others (cross-cutting)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: All collisions detected and resolved correctly, score updates on enemy destruction, enemy bullets damage player, player bullets destroy enemies, shields degrade on all hits, performance acceptable

Create Slice 6 — Enemy Fire System. Read US-005, architecture.md, Slice 1.

**Slice Title**: Slice 6 — Enemy Fire System

**Description**: Random enemy bullet firing with max 3 simultaneous bullets, object pooling for reuse, collision integration.

**Deliverables**:
1. EnemyBullet entity: position, velocity, collision box
2. Bullet pool: max 3 bullets, reuse pool slots on exit
3. Fire logic: random timer per column, one random enemy fires per trigger
4. Fire rate control: reduce interval between fires as wave progresses
5. Bullet movement: downward trajectory with canvas bounds checking
6. Rendering: draw enemy bullets to canvas
7. Integration with collision manager (from Slice 5)

**Related User Stories**: US-005 (enemy fire), US-006 (collisions)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: Enemy bullets fire at random intervals, max 3 on screen simultaneously, bullets move downward predictably, bullets exit screen and return to pool, fire interval decreases with wave progression, bullets render visible, integration with collision system works

Create Slice 7 — Mystery Ship & Bonus. Read US-006, architecture.md, Slice 1.

**Slice Title**: Slice 7 — Mystery Ship & Bonus Encounters

**Description**: Mystery ship crosses top of screen at random intervals with random point values (50, 100, 150, 300), collision integration.

**Deliverables**:
1. MysteryShip entity: position, velocity, point value, alive flag
2. Spawn logic: random interval timer (e.g., 10-20 seconds)
3. Point value generation: random choice of 50, 100, 150, 300 pts
4. Rendering: draw mystery ship sprite to canvas
5. Movement: horizontal trajectory across top of screen
6. Bounds checking: remove when exits screen, respawn after interval
7. Integration with collision manager: player bullet destroys, adds bonus score

**Related User Stories**: US-006 (collision detection & scoring - mystery ship bonuses)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: Mystery ship spawns at random intervals, renders at top with unique sprite, moves horizontally smoothly, point value assigned randomly, player bullet destroys ship + adds bonus score, ship exits and respawns after interval, no impact on core game if disabled

Create Slice 8 — Wave Progression & Difficulty Scaling. Read US-007, architecture.md, Slices 1-2.

**Slice Title**: Slice 8 — Wave Progression & Difficulty Scaling

**Description**: Implement wave transitions, difficulty increases (enemy speed, fire rate), lives reset, score persistence.

**Deliverables**:
1. Wave counter: increment on victory, display in HUD
2. Difficulty parameters: base speed, fire interval, tied to wave count
3. Formation reset logic: respawn 55 enemies with new speed
4. Lives reset: set to 3 on new wave (but score persists)
5. Score persistence: carry score across waves
6. Victory condition: detect all enemies destroyed
7. Restart logic: reset to wave 1, score 0, lives 3 on restart from game over

**Related User Stories**: US-007 (game states & wave progression), US-002 (enemy formation speed scaling), US-005 (enemy fire rate scaling)
**Related Epics**: Epic 0 — MVP
**Success Criteria**: Victory triggers when all enemies destroyed, wave increments on victory, new formation spawns with increased speed, enemy fire interval decreases, lives reset to 3 on new wave, score displays cumulatively, game over screen shows final score, restart resets all state to initial values
